name: Have Children
overview: Scripture reveals that having children is a divine blessing and a sacred responsibility entrusted by God. In Genesis 1:28, God commands humanity to be fruitful and multiply, establishing the foundation for family and stewardship over creation. Psalm 127:3 emphasizes that children are a heritage from the Lord and a reward from Him, highlighting their value and origin. Proverbs 22:6 instructs parents to diligently train their children in the ways of the Lord so that they remain faithful throughout their lives, underscoring the importance of godly upbringing.
